end.summary:
Practised representing 11–20 as one group of ten and extra ones.
Saanvi counted loose sticks and identified fourteen as ten and four.
They mixed up the bundle’s appearance as one object with its value of ten.
The bundle-versus-one confusion remained at the end; teach-back was not passed.
Lesson stopped when Saanvi asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised making numbers with one bundle of ten and extra loose sticks. They tried counting the loose sticks and said fourteen could be ten and four, but mixed up the bundle being one object with its value of ten; this was not corrected by the end. At home, show a clearly labelled bundle of 10 sticks beside loose sticks and ask, “How many altogether?” for 11–14.
